description: LIVE-1 / F2 regression (AI attacker, human defender, two save batches): the attacker's shooting is the atomic SHOOT action the Custodes AI sends, split between the Dakkajet (1 W left, T2, no save) and Gretchin Beta; the Ork player rolls each batch in the AllocationGroupOverlay ('Computer allocates wounds' OFF). Batch 1 kills the jet: on Done the unit_destroyed window opens for Player 2 with FLYIN' HEADBUTT and Deadly Demise is HELD while batch 2's overlay is already up. Rolling batch 2 is refused until the window is answered (the overlay would otherwise write casualties the phase then refuses to record). Declining the window resolves the held Deadly Demise; batch 2 is then rolled and the AI's activation completes. Setup privileges: P2's detachment is Flyboyz, units repositioned, both players 4 CP.

steps.comment: the Custodes AI's atomic SHOOT: m1-m2 at the Dakkajet, m3-m5 at the Gretchin (pauses for the human defender's saves)
steps.script:
var w = "guardian_spear___ranged_ranged"
var assignments = [{"weapon_id": w, "target_unit_id": "U_DAKKAJET_A", "model_ids": ["m1", "m2"]}, {"weapon_id": w, "target_unit_id": "U_GRETCHIN_C", "model_ids": ["m3", "m4", "m5"]}]
var r = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().execute_action({"type": "SHOOT", "actor_unit_id": "U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_F", "player": 1, "payload": {"assignments": assignments, "rng_seed": 5}})
return "%s/%d" % [str(r.get("success", false)), PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().pending_save_data.size()]

steps.comment: batch 2's overlay is already up behind the window
keyboard / pad activation of Roll Saves while the window waits
back to the decision (the examine bar sits under the allocation overlay; Escape is the documented way back)
declined: the held Deadly Demise resolved
